posts.trend: Inside Apple's Second Layoff Round: Why Fitness+ Audio Teams Were Cut Weeks After 200+ Job Losses
posts.context: Corporate wellness is a series of checklist tasks designed to shift liability back to the employee.
posts.angle: The office environment systematically destroys the spine while prescribing hydration and breathing breaks as the cure.
slides: You asked the company doctor about your posture.

"Is it the ergonomic chair?"
"No, it is the nine hours of sitting."
"Is it the blue-light glasses?"
"No, it is the twelve hours of staring."

"Can I have a standing desk?"

"Drink more water."
posts.caption: Whose HR manager is this?
posts.rank_verdict: The middle slide feels slightly like a sterile Q&A pamphlet rather than a harsh, active rant from real corporate life.
